update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.80 - Unity Cup Train-Only Mode, URA Duel Handler, Spark Trait Reroll
Added ----- - Unity Cup train-only mode: new toggle in Training Settings → Behavior → Unity Cup. When enabled, the bot always trains instead of running optional races. Mandatory race days, scheduled races, fan/trophy requirements, maiden race, injury/mood recovery, and energy banking are still respected. - URA Duel handler: detects the "Contest of" stat duel screen during URA Finale, picks the trainee's highest stat (Speed/Power/Wits), navigates the carousel to that option, and confirms. - Spark Trait Reroll: on the Traits reroll screen, automatically rerolls all spark traits up to a configurable limit and stops early once the configured star threshold is met.
